## Description

An elongated haptorid ciliate (250–500 µm) with a long proboscis (almost a third of the body) armed
with a ventral row of toxicysts; it strikes ciliates and rotifers, which are paralysed or killed, and
swallows them through the cytostome at the base of the proboscis.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 1 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

~250 µm. The proboscis is the anterior third of the ellipse (a body horn would not let the division
close yet); the toxicyst reach is the proboscis. The proboscis sways from side to side while swimming
([shape wave](../../mechanics/shape-changes.md), `kind = "sway"`). Reach, paralysis and sway estimated.

## Not implemented yet

- The proboscis is not a separate body process.
- Real cells reach 500 µm.

## Unique and shared mechanics

Shares [toxicysts](../../mechanics/feeding-and-phagocytosis.md) with *Didinium* and *Litonotus*; the sway wave is
unique to it.
